items.given: a clean candidate workspace with the pinned .NET 8 SDK
items.when: the adapter build and test commands run
items.then: both commands finish with declared allowed exit codes

items.given: records whose account, instrument, and currency vary only by case or surrounding whitespace
items.then: the records are compared using trimmed uppercase values

items.given: two trade rows with the same trade identifier
items.then: the first row is canonical and every later row is reported as a duplicate break

items.given: eligible counterpart records exactly on each configured tolerance boundary
items.then: the closed-interval comparisons accept the boundary values

items.given: a trade with non-positive quantity or net amount
an override targeting a break with no concrete counterpart
items.then: no match is manufactured and the break remains visible

items.given: two override instructions target the same eligible trade
items.then: the first may apply and the later instruction appears as a stale override
all four declared output files exist with stable headers and deterministic ordering

items.given: the same business date and byte-identical input files
items.when: the candidate runs twice against the same output state
items.then: result files are equivalent and run-ledger.csv contains no duplicate run entry

items.when: an external tool validates and invokes it
items.then: the adapter needs no knowledge of the candidate's internal architecture
